title: US officials say string of November outages was not a cyberattack, Hankook Ilbo reports
date_note: Date of the officials' statements per Hankook Ilbo (published 19 Nov); the outages it lists run 12 to 17 November.
summary: Hankook Ilbo lists outages at Outlook and Teams (12th), an FAA communications system (13th), United Airlines and JPMorgan Chase (16th), and Apple and an NSA internal network (17th). It reports Secretary of State Marco Rubio saw no evidence of hackers or hostile states, and DNI director Jay Clayton blamed maintenance and technical changes. The FBI took FAA equipment for analysis.
plain: A Korean newspaper reports that US officials say a run of outages at several big services was caused by individual technical problems, not a cyberattack.
exec: US officials link some outages to rushed patching of newly found flaws, per one report; a cyberattack is not fully ruled out by a quoted former analyst.
impact: Outages named by the article: Outlook and Teams, FAA communications, United Airlines, JPMorgan Chase, Apple services, an NSA internal network.

validation.note: Only Hankook Ilbo read (relaying ABC and others; not opened). Statements by Rubio and Clayton are as reported there, not read on a primary page.
